# Localley

> Localley is a travel helper for Asia (Korea, Japan, Thailand, Vietnam, Taiwan, Singapore and more). It has show-to-staff phrase cards, menu help, how-to-pay guides and "open near me" lists, plus a database of local spots with a Localley Score (0-6) that rates how local a place is, and trip plans built from those spots.

## Start here

- [Home](https://www.localley.io/): what Localley does and where to start.
- [Local spots](https://www.localley.io/spots): browse rated local spots by city and category.
- [Seoul spots](https://www.localley.io/spots?city=seoul): local spots in Seoul.
- [Tokyo spots](https://www.localley.io/spots?city=tokyo): local spots in Tokyo.
- [Bangkok spots](https://www.localley.io/spots?city=bangkok): local spots in Bangkok.
- [Singapore spots](https://www.localley.io/spots?city=singapore): local spots in Singapore.
- [Taipei spots](https://www.localley.io/spots?city=taipei): local spots in Taipei.

## Travel help

- [Help me say this](https://www.localley.io/help): phrase cards to show to staff, by country.
- [Korea phrase cards](https://www.localley.io/help/korea): Korean phrases for ordering, paying, directions, allergies and emergencies.
- [How to pay in Korea](https://www.localley.io/help/korea/pay): cards, T-money, cash and what to say at the counter.
- [Menu help in Korea](https://www.localley.io/help/korea/menu): how to order from a Korean menu.
- [Open nearby in Korea](https://www.localley.io/help/korea/open): spots open near you now.
- [Japan phrase cards](https://www.localley.io/help/japan): Japanese phrases for travellers.
- [Thailand phrase cards](https://www.localley.io/help/thailand): Thai phrases for travellers.
- [Vietnam phrase cards](https://www.localley.io/help/vietnam): Vietnamese phrases for travellers.
- [Taiwan phrase cards](https://www.localley.io/help/taiwan): Chinese phrases for Taiwan.

## Guides and plans

- [Journal](https://www.localley.io/blog): field notes and guides.
- [Paying in Seoul](https://www.localley.io/blog/paying-in-seoul): what works for payment in Seoul and what does not.
- [Viral spots](https://www.localley.io/trending): places in the news this month, with sources.
- [Itinerary templates](https://www.localley.io/templates): ready-made trip plans by city and pace.

- [Pricing](https://www.localley.io/pricing): Free, Pro and Premium plans.
